meta.title: Evomon mutations (rare variants) data

sources.label: Roonby - How to Get Shiny Prismatic Evomons in Roblox Evomon
sources.note: Community-reported rates: Shiny ~0.2% (about 1 in 500) with a 600-capture pity; Prismatic ~0.8% (about 1 in 125) with a 150-capture pity. Treats both as variants that roll on encounters. Explains the Shiny Prismatic combo: raise the Prismatic counter to 149, stop capturing that species, battle until a Shiny appears, then capture to trigger the Prismatic pity at the same time.

sources.label: Pro Game Guides - Complete Evomon Beginner's Guide
sources.note: Lists Shiny and Prismatic as the two mutations. Describes Shiny as rarer and Prismatic as far more common. This guide attributes a random stat buff plus a cosmetic to Shiny, which conflicts with sources that call Shiny cosmetic-only; recorded both readings in item effect text.

sources.label: Gamezebo - Evomon Shiny Hunting Guide (Including Prismatic and Pris Shinies)
sources.note: Confirms the per-species pity counter shown in the bottom-left of the combat screen and that pity differs per Evomon. Example given: Pebble has a 150 Prismatic pity and a 600 Shiny pity. Confirms Shiny Prismatic ('Pris Shiny') combined forms are obtainable.

sources.label: Sportskeeda - How to get Prismatic Balls in Evomon
sources.note: Clarifies that the Prismatic Ball is a separate paid capture item (guaranteed SSS talent plus a sparkling effect) and is not the source of the Prismatic mutation. Used to keep the Prismatic variant distinct from the Prismatic Ball in this collection.

meta.notes: Two confirmed rare variants (mutations): Shiny and Prismatic. Sparkle was dropped because it appears only on the SEO fan-wiki cluster (evomon.org, evomonroblox.wiki, evomonwiki.wiki) and is not confirmed by any first-tier source (Pro Game Guides, Roonby, Gamezebo). 'Colorful' and 'talent' were also excluded as unverified. All odds are community-reported estimates, not officially published rates. Pity is per-species and varies, so it is given as a Pebble example rather than a universal number. The Prismatic variant here is the on-creature mutation; the separate paid Prismatic Ball is covered in the balls collection. collectionSection is a single shared 'Variants' value so the page renders as one flat variant list under a CATALOG_SECTION_OVERRIDES entry (groupKey collectionSection), not a per-variant grouping.

items.name: Prismatic
items.effect: Cosmetic only: adds glowing body parts and unique visual effects
items.howToGet: Rolls randomly on wild encounters and egg hatches, with a per-species pity counter shown in the bottom-left of the combat screen
items.bestUse: The more common of the two variants, so it is a good first variant to chase while you learn how the per-species pity counter works.
items.cardSummary: Prismatic is the more common Evomon variant. Community estimates put it around 0.8% per encounter (roughly 1 in 125), with a per-species pity that guarantees one after a set number of captures (about 150 for Pebble). It is a cosmetic form that adds glowing parts and visual effects, and it is separate from the paid Prismatic Ball capture item.
items.sourceStatus: Confirmed across Roonby, Gamezebo, and Pro Game Guides; odds are community estimates
items.imageStatus: accepted-missing: text-only. Prismatic is an in-game visual effect applied to a creature, not a standalone item. No reusable source has a clean Prismatic-specific render (evomon.org serves only base creature art: pebble.png returns 200 but prismatic.png and shiny-pebble.png return 404). A base creature render would not show the Prismatic effect, so none is used. Needs in-game capture.

items.name: Shiny
items.effect: Recolor: a unique alternate color palette for that species. Sources disagree on whether Shiny also grants a small random stat buff or is cosmetic only.
items.howToGet: Rolls randomly on wild encounters and egg hatches, with a per-species pity counter shown in the bottom-left of the combat screen
items.bestUse: Rarer than Prismatic, so it is the headline hunt. You can also chase a Shiny Prismatic by holding the Prismatic counter near its pity, then capturing once a Shiny appears.
items.cardSummary: Shiny is the rarer Evomon variant, community-estimated at around 0.2% per encounter (roughly 1 in 500) with a much higher per-species pity than Prismatic (about 600 for Pebble). It gives the species a unique alternate color palette; sources disagree on whether it also adds a small random stat buff. Combining it with the Prismatic pity produces a Shiny Prismatic form.
items.sourceStatus: Confirmed across Roonby, Gamezebo, and Pro Game Guides; stat-buff claim conflicts between sources; odds are community estimates
items.imageStatus: accepted-missing: text-only. Shiny is an in-game recolor applied to a creature, not a standalone item. No reusable source has a clean Shiny-specific render (evomon.org serves only base creature art: pebble.png returns 200 but shiny.png and shiny-pebble.png return 404). A base creature render would not show the Shiny palette, so none is used. Needs in-game capture.
